what: The ring-out physics layer the mod applies on top of 9 Kings' battlefield: Bopl Battle's core rule (knock the other side off the platform) translated to grid combat.

rows.effect: Any unit pushed beyond the battlefield edge is destroyed, regardless of HP
A unit that would be pushed past the edge by 0 tiles or less into a wall stays and takes 2 impact damage
A unit on the last row before the edge takes +1 push from every knockback
If the enemy king unit is ring-out, its whole army shatters: instant battle victory
Blob units survive one lethal hit per battle at 1 HP (squish), then are destroyed normally
